title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Treylon Burks (shoulder) fully practices Wednesday
items.desc: Treylon Burks (shoulder) fully practiced for the Commanders on Wednesday.
items.impact: Burks was dealing with some kind of a shoulder injury following Week 4, but it's not a serious issue and didn't prevent him from logging a full practice this week. Look for him to continue to contribute on this offense moving forward, though he won't have much fantasy value for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Andrew Thomas (groin) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Andrew Thomas is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Thomas continues to deal with a groin injury. His status will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Rachaad White (shoulder) officially limited Wednesday
items.desc: Rachaad White (shoulder) was officially limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: White missed last week's game due to a shoulder injury that he recently suffered, but he seems to be recovering well and was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday. His potential return in Week 5 would be bad news for the fantasy value of Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) moving forward.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jason Pinnock (concussion) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Jason Pinnock is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Pinnock is in concussion protocol. His status for Week 5 is up in the air.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ben Sinnott (rib) limited Wednesday
items.desc: Ben Sinnott (rib) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: To no surprise, Sinnott was limited at practice on Wednesday due to his nagging rib issue. He remains off of the fantasy radar for the foreseeable future, however.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Najee Harris (personal) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Najee Harris is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: It is a personal related absence for Harris.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chig Okonkwo (hamstring) listed as limited Wednesday
items.desc: Chig Okonkwo (hamstring) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Okonkwo was able to make his return to the lineup in Week 4 after missing a bit of time due to a hamstring injury. It's not surprising that the team continues to limit his workload at practice because of it, but he still should be good to play through it in Week 5, assuming he doesn't re-aggravate the injury sometime during the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chauncey Golston (neck) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Chauncey Golston is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Golston will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jeremy McNichols (quad) logs limited practice Wednesday
items.desc: Jeremy McNichols (quad) logged a limited practice session on Wednesday.
items.impact: Wednesday was McNichols' first practice back after having his practice window opened, and he was officially able to participate in a limited capacity. It looks like he will be back in the lineup sooner rather than later, although he will likely be relegated to a depth role in the team's backfield for the time being.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Malik Nabers (knee) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Malik Nabers is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Nabers is dealing with a knee injury. He did leave last Sunday's game before returning. His status will need to be monitored in practice the next couple of days.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) limited at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The young running back was left limited at the team's first practice of the week on Wednesday due to a groin injury that he's managing. He hasn't been very effective to start the year, so fantasy managers shouldn't be looking to start him this week even if he's fully healthy and available to play for the Commanders.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Frankie Luvu (groin) limited Wednesday
items.desc: Frankie Luvu (groin) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Luvu continues to be limited at practice due to the groin injury that he's recovering from. He was able to play through it last week and should be able to again this week, however, assuming he suffers no setbacks between now and Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Terry McLaurin (hamstring) officially a non-participant Wednesday
items.desc: Terry McLaurin (hamstring) was officially a non-participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The star wideout was unable to practice on Wednesday due to a hamstring injury that he's dealing with. He was able to do a bit of work off to the side, but the team may still end up letting him sit out this week in order to rest and recover from that injury. If that's the case, QB Jayden Daniels (elbow) will see a steep dip in his fantasy outlook for Week 5.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Sam Cosmi (concussion/throat) limited Wednesday
items.desc: Sam Cosmi (concussion/throat) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Cosmi was able to return to practice on Wednesday, though he remained limited and in a red non-contact jersey. It looks like he's trending the right way with his recovery right now, but it remains to be seen whether or not he'll be ready to play by Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mykel Williams (knee) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Mykel Williams was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Williams remains hopeful to return on Sunday against the Seahawks.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mike Evans (rib) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Mike Evans was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Evans played through a rib injury last week. He remains likely to do so on Sunday against the Seahawks.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Stefon Diggs (hamstring) doesn't practice Wednesday
items.desc: Stefon Diggs (hamstring) did not practice for the Commanders on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran wasn't able to participate in Wednesday's practice, as he's now listed on the injury report with a hamstring issue of some kind. Fantasy managers should be gearing up for him to not play in Week 5, though we won't know more for sure about his status until later this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kaelon Black (illness) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Kaelon Black is limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Black is dealing with an illness. He should still be good to go on Sunday against the Seahawks.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Marques Sigle (ankle) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Marques Sigle did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Sigle is expected to miss time with an ankle injury.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kyle Juszczyk (knee) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Kyle Juszczyk is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Juszczyk remains week-to-week and is unlikely to play on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: James Thompson Jr. (ankle) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: James Thompson Jr. is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Thompson remains unlikely to return on Sunday against the Seahawks.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ashton Dulin (hamstring) absent from practice Wednesday
items.desc: Ashton Dulin (hamstring) was absent from Indianapolis' practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Dulin is unable to stay healthy right now. He suffered a hamstring injury in Week 4 and wasn't able to practice on Wednesday, which puts his availability for Sunday's game in jeopardy. Look for Keenan Allen (rest/groin) to see more work if Dulin is unable to play this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Nick Bosa (calf) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Nick Bosa is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Bosa remains unlikely to return on Sunday against the Seahawks.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Keenan Allen (rest/groin) limited Wednesday
items.desc: Keenan Allen (rest/groin) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran wideout was limited by a groin injury on Wednesday, which isn't surprising after that same issue left him sidelined in Week 4. It remains to be seen whether or not he will play on Sunday, but either way he shouldn't be viewed as a strong fantasy option.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Rico Dowdle (toe) logs limited practice Wednesday
items.desc: Rico Dowdle (toe) logged a limited practice session on Wednesday.
items.impact: Dowdle has been out for multiple weeks while tending to a toe injury of some kind, but he was able to make his return to practice on Wednesday and was officially limited for the Steelers. He will have a chance to play in Week 5, and whenever his return comes, it will unfortunately mean less work for Jaylen Warren, who has been killing it as the team's clear-cut RB1 for the past couple of weeks.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) officially limited Wednesday
items.desc: Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) was officially a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran is now dealing with a foot injury of some kind. He was officially limited because of it on Wednesday, but he was also seen moving around on a scooter in the locker room, which makes it seem like a long-shot that he will play this week. If he's sidelined, fantasy managers should look for Roman Wilson to continue to benefit from his absence for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jalen Ramsey (wrist) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Jalen Ramsey (wrist) missed Pittsburgh's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Ramsey was able to play in Week 4 despite managing a broken wrist, so it's no surprise that the team let him take Wednesday's practice off in order to rest and recover. It looks likely that he will play in Week 5, which is good news for Pittsburgh ahead of a matchup against the Indianapolis Colts.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Khalil Mack (rest) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Khalil Mack is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: It is a rest day for Mack. He should be back at practice on Thursday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kayode Awosika (fibula) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Kayode Awosika is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Awosika remains uncertain heading into Week 5 against the Broncos.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Donte Jackson (hamstring) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Donte Jackson is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Jackson is dealing with a hamstring injury. His status is uncertain for Week 5 against the Broncos.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Derwin James Jr. (hamstring) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Derwin James Jr. is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: James remains week-to-week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Trevor Penning (concussion) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Trevor Penning is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Penning was placed in concussion protocol. He is unlikely to be available in Week 5 against the Broncos.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Joe Alt (neck) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Joe Alt is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Alt left last Sunday's game early with the injury. His status is uncertain heading into Week 5.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Joe Thuney (pec) a non-participant Wednesday
items.desc: Joe Thuney (pec) was a non-participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The Bears are dealing with several key injuries on their offensive line right now. Thuney is among those names, but it's possible he only missed Wednesday's practice as a load management day. The health of Chicago's offensive front is worth watching throughout the week ahead of a matchup against the Packers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rashawn Slater (ankle) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Rashawn Slater is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Slater remains a potential candidate to be placed on IR.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jonah Jackson (ankle) absent from practice Wednesday
items.desc: Jonah Jackson (ankle) was absent from Chicago's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The Bears are dealing with several injuries on their offensive line right now, including with Jackson, who missed Wednesday's practice due to an ankle issue. It still looks likely that he will play in Week 5, however, but we won't know for sure until later on in the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Darnell Wright (ankle) a non-participant Wednesday
items.desc: Darnell Wright (ankle) was a non-participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Wright wasn't able to practice on Wednesday. He's currently dealing with an ankle injury and is likely considered day-to-day for the time being as a result. His absence this week would be bad news for Chicago's offense, but we won't get official word on his status until later on in the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: D'Andre Swift (hip/knee) doesn't practice Wednesday
items.desc: D'Andre Swift (hip/knee) did not take part in Chicago's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Swift is currently dealing with a couple of different injuries. The team held him out of Wednesday's practice as a result. but it doesn't seem like he's at real risk of being sidelined in Week 5. Still, it would be worth it for fantasy managers to keep tabs on his status the rest of the week, especially with Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) also on the team's injury report.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) missed Chicago's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Monangai was not able to practice on Wednesday due to a couple of different injuries that he's dealing with. Neither of them seem to be serious, however, so his absence was likely a load management move on the part of the team. Fantasy managers should expect business as usual from him this week if he's back at practice on Thursday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Trey Hendrickson (finger) seen with cast Wednesday
items.desc: Trey Hendrickson (finger) was seen wearing a cast at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran was seen in street clothes and not participating at Baltimore's practice on Wednesday. He recently underwent a procedure on his finger and was spotted with a large cast on it, which is an indication that he still needs more time to recover before he'll be back in the lineup. Baltimore's defense will continue to be weaker than usual for as long as he's out.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josiah Trotter (knee) off injury report Thursday
items.desc: Josiah Trotter is off the injury report for Thursday's game against the Cowboys.
items.impact: Trotter returned to a full practice on Wednesday. He will be good to go on Thursday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chase McLaughlin (hip/groin) off injury report Thursday
items.desc: Chase McLaughlin is off the injury report for Thursday's game against the Cowboys.
items.impact: McLaughlin was added to the injury report on Tuesday. He will be good to go on Thursday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ko Kieft (elbow) off injury report Thursday
items.desc: Ko Kieft is off the injury report for Thursday's game against the Cowboys.
items.impact: Kieft will remain off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rueben Bain Jr. (groin/shoulder) off injury report Thursday
items.desc: Rueben Bain Jr. is off the injury report for Thursday's game against the Cowboys.
items.impact: Bain was a full participant in practice all week. He'll be good to go on Thursday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Antoine Winfield Jr. (rib) ruled out Thursday
items.desc: Antoine Winfield Jr. has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Cowboys.
items.impact: Winfield was unable to practice all week. The Bucs secondary will remain short-handed.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Benjamin Morrison (quad) ruled out Thursday
items.desc: Benjamin Morrison has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Cowboys.
items.impact: Morrison was unable to practice all week. The Bucs secondary will remain short-handed.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Baker Mayfield (thumb) ruled out Thursday
items.desc: Baker Mayfield has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Cowboys.
items.impact: Mayfield will remain sidelined as expected. Jalon Daniels will draw another start for Tampa Bay.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: SirVocea Dennis (ankle/foot) ruled out Thursday
items.desc: SirVocea Dennis has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Cowboys.
items.impact: Dennis will be sidelined on Thursday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Joey Porter Jr. (ankle) off injury report Thursday
items.desc: Joey Porter Jr. is off the injury report for Thursday's game against the Buccaneers.
items.impact: Porter is good to go for his second game since being traded to the Cowboys.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: CeeDee Lamb (thigh) off injury report Thursday
items.desc: CeeDee Lamb is off the injury report for Thursday's game against the Buccaneers.
items.impact: Lamb practiced in full all week. He remains a locked and loaded WR1.
